Take it anywhere

Put the Toolkit on your phone.

Once opened online, the core prompts and project guides are available offline. External learning resources still need internet.

IPHONE / IPAD

Safari

Open the site in Safari, tap Share, then choose “Add to Home Screen” and tap Add.

ANDROID

Chrome

Open the site in Chrome, use the menu or install prompt, and select “Install app.”

DESKTOP

Chrome / Edge

Look for the Install icon in the address bar or use your browser's app installation menu.
